newsitem.title: USA: Dow gains more than 100 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow gains more than 100 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 100 points in mid-afternoon trading on Tuesday in anticipation that the Federal Reserve will keep interest rates unchanged.
At 2:15 p.m. EDT (1815 GMT), the 30-share Dow was up 100.34 points at 7,903.70.

The central bank's Federal Open Market Committee convened for its sixth interest rate meeting this year at 9 a.m. EDT (1300 GMT) and is expected to announce its decision around 2:15 p.m. EDT (1815 GMT).
